title: Tread Inspection Standard — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
A tread inspection is the measured evidence for every warranty decision on a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty tire. The set must be in status active when a tread inspection is recorded.

- One inspection record is written per wheel position measured.
- The depth is the lowest reading in any main groove, in whole 32nds of an inch.
- The wear pattern is the one the technician records: even, irregular alignment, irregular inflation or damage.
- The inspection is performed by a Crestline technician at a store. A depth the customer measured at home, or a reading from another shop, is not an inspection and is never recorded as one.
- An inspection supports a warranty decision only for the inspection validity period set by the treadwear adjustment terms; after that a new inspection is needed.

**Recorded versus not recorded (hypothetical readings):** a technician's reading of 2/32 in at the lowest main groove with even wear is recorded for that position; a customer's coin-test reading phoned in to the care center is not.
